analysis.title: Marketcolour + CTA Update / SBM (I) / Richemont / Enel
key_insights: US equities fell broadly on 11/16 to start a heavy catalyst week: SPX -192bps to 7416, NDX -267bps to 27197, RTY -170bps to 2742. 8 of 11 sectors closed lower.
Tech led the decline at -2.98%, followed by Communication Services at -2.82% and Energy at -2.09%. Staples rose 0.34%. NVDA fell 4.5%, DRAM 6%, SMH 5% and Neoclouds 7%.
Thematic baskets: GS AI Semis basket (GSCHSMHX) -5.48% and GS Power Up America basket (GSENEPOW) -3.09%.
In Europe, EU Semis (GSSBSEMI) fell 2.3% and Miners (GSXEMINE) fell 2.7%. EU Defense (GSSBDEFE) rose 70bps. SX5E has outperformed SPX by about 8% since early October.
Since 2008 the average market trade size has fallen 47% to 136 shares per trade. On-exchange average trade size excluding the opening and closing auctions is 108 shares year-to-date.

GS flags EU Staples (GSXESTAP) as vulnerable. The sector had its best monthly performance on record while 1y forward EPS revisions lagged the market by more than 10pp YTD. It now trades at a 16% premium to SXXP.
CTAs are long Europe and short US. Short-term thresholds in Europe are about 2% lower. CTAs are as short NDX as they have been in the last decade.

US-listed ETF shorts fell 8.6%, the largest percentage covering in 7 months, led by Large Cap Equity, Credit and Tech ETFs. Global equity funds took in $98bn net in the week ending November 11, against $89bn the prior week, with DM inflows driven mainly by US funds.

SBM Offshore initiated with a EUR43 price target (25% upside). GS sees SBM as the best-positioned FPSO contractor for a deepwater FID wave across Guyana, Brazil and West Africa, and says consensus does not reflect the expected pace of FPSO awards.

Richemont: Buy, price target raised to CHF230 from CHF225 (30% upside). The 2027E EBIT margin forecast rises to 23.1% (22.2% excluding one-offs) from 21.9%. The improvement mainly reflects a one-off tariff refund.
Enel: Buy, EUR12 price target (20% upside). A Strategic Update is due in Feb-2027, possibly at a CMD. GS sees upside risk to current targets despite regulatory intervention.

market_movers.rationale: SBM Offshore is the global FPSO leader with about 40% market share. GS expects a deepwater FID wave in Guyana, Brazil and West Africa that consensus does not yet reflect.
Target raised from CHF225 on stronger underlying margins. The 2027E EBIT margin forecast rises to 23.1% from 21.9%, driving a 6.1% increase in adjusted EPS, partly from a one-off tariff refund.
Strategic Update due Feb-2027. GS sees upside risk to current targets. 2028 clean EPS estimate is EUR0.83, slightly ahead of guidance and consensus.
NVDA fell 4.5% in the 11/16 session as Tech sold off.

sector_views.rationale: The sector had its best month on record while 1y forward EPS revisions lagged the market by more than 10pp YTD, leaving it at a 16% premium to SXXP.

earnings_insights: Richemont: 2027E EBIT margin forecast of 23.1% (22.2% excluding one-offs) from 21.9%. Adjusted EPS rises 6.1% for 2027E, with 1.7-2.7% upgrades across 2028-30E. The 2027E improvement mainly reflects a one-off tariff refund.

Enel: GS 2028 clean EPS estimate of EUR0.83 (about 11.5x P/E), slightly ahead of guidance and Visible Alpha consensus. GS 2030 estimate of EUR0.92 (10.5x P/E), a touch ahead of guidance and 9% ahead of the street.
